comparisons.behavior: OrderPaymentQueries.PaymentMethodTotals counts non-electronic split legs immediately even IsPaidfalse; Composer passes entire Total-refund and IsPaidfalse to DeliveryRules. FIN019 independent challenge already established overstated custody for pending mixed delivery.
comparisons.counterevidence: Reports may intentionally use different row scopes, but same specific pending-mixed order has actual immediate leg already posted; this is not merely period scope.

comparisons.behavior: OrderEnumMapping writes Pending as lowercase pending. OrderMapper stores it, DeliveryQueryService returns unchanged string, ApiClient.ReadResultAsync deserializes DTO without case conversion. DeliveryViewModel checks uppercase Pending in PaymentStateLabel and IsPaymentUnconfirmed. For canonical lowercase pending/IsPaidfalse row, source resolves label to collect-on-delivery and warningfalse.
comparisons.related: FIN019; exact existing IDs searched, no new canonical ID allocated here
comparisons.entry_points: GET dispatch board -> BoardRow properties -> DeliveryView bindings119-124; MarkReady/OpenAssign commands use permission/busy only and XAML visibility uses delivery status, no pending check.
comparisons.counterevidence: Historical noncanonical uppercase row would display warning; this does not correct ordinary mapper-produced lowercase values. No native UI or authenticated HTTP exercised.

comparisons.behavior: DeliveryDto.AmountToCollectPiastres is Composer Total-refund even when PaymentAlreadySettledtrue. Client OpenOutcome always pre-fills that amount. Server result separately derives zero responsibility for prepaid nonCash; unchanged positive form with blank reason is rejected by AssertCollectionAmount. This is an actionable disagreement between client default and server invariant; zero can be entered manually.
comparisons.example: Fully paid Card delivery total10000, no refund, IsPaidtrue: DTO10000, dialog defaults10000, server expected0; default confirmation requires variance reason. With a user-supplied reason, server can record positive collected on a prepaid delivery, but no real duplicate collection or settlement was executed.
comparisons.counterevidence: Server validation blocks silent no-reason overcollection. Client field is editable. Normal COD expects full amount and is unaffected. Gross order value is a useful separate field and need not be deleted.

recommendations: Use typed/centralized wire state contract or explicit canonical parse; do not fix only label while leaving authority rules.

Separate gross order value, confirmed paid amount and actual collectibility in DTO/domain contract; have client initialize from authoritative responsibility, with explicit pending-payment freeze or authorized conversion policy.
Preserve server-side reason/approval/idempotency/locking and distinct refund allocation semantics. Audit proposes only; no fix implemented.
required_tests: Pure canonical pending/confirmed/cancelled/null BoardRow state mappings, including exact serialized lowercase strings.

Prepaid card/confirmed electronic, all-immediate Multi, CashCOD and partially pending Multi: API projection, client default and handler responsibility agree; zero prepaid outcome succeeds without invented variance.
Authenticated isolated pending dispatch policy tests with legitimate actors and no physical printing, only after owner authorization for stateful environment.
independent_review: Pending financial specialist; no claim root independently corroborated its own newly discovered candidates.
